title: A Primer of the Long Barrel
summary: Teaches a first-time student to seat, load, aim and guard with a rifle using body strength alone.

title: Drill-Book of Patch and Ball
summary: Drills the paper cartridge, greased patch and sling handling that a skin-hardened beginner needs to load and hold a rifle.

title: Handbook of the Steady Rest
summary: Shows muscle-trained students how to fire from knee, hip and rail rests and to defend a rifle at close quarters.

title: Workbook of Sights and Breath
summary: Trains sight alignment, breath control and recoil bracing with plain bodily drills for students whose tendons have begun to harden.

title: Canon of the Standing Rifleman
summary: Sets out the full body-only routine of the standing rifleman, from offhand shot to bayonet bind and quick reload.

title: First Lessons in Rifled Aim
summary: Introduces a newly awakened student to steadying the rifle with a thin thread of circulating qi.

title: The Rifleman's Range Workbook
summary: Teaches range reading, sight setting and light qi loading drills for the first-year rifleman at the practice butts.

title: A Short Treatise on Windage
summary: Explains how to read smoke and grass drift and offset the aim for it, with qi held steady in the hands.

title: Handbook for the Rifled Bore
summary: Covers seating the ball in the grooves, keeping the bore clean and fighting off the rifle when pressed.

title: Drills for the Prone Marksman
summary: Drills firing, crawling and reloading from the ground so a qi-awakened student can shoot from low cover.

title: Canon of Measured Fire
